source.title: Anyone else not getting any extra materials from Dragonflight disenchanting crafted items?

quote: around 600 Enchanted Writhebark Wand and never recived a reasonant crystal
notes: First-person Reddit report dated November 10, 2024: player states they disenchanted AROUND 600 Enchanted Writhebark Wands and received NO Resonant Crystal among them. Approximate wand count is NOT a measured completed-cast denominator; casts and all per-cast zero/positive histograms remain null, despite explicitly reported zero material units/hits. The separate ~8000 crafted bracers mentioned in the same post have unspecified exact gear ID/output and are NOT another denominator or study. Profession at report: 25 Dragon Isles Enchanting and 40 points Draconic Disenchantment; player asks whether TWW profession tools or specialization not working caused the outcome, neither explanation verified. This is a late-November-2024 TWW-era anecdote, not a Dragonflight launch baseline nor a quantified drop-rate estimate; keep separate from any older same-item or epoch cohorts and do not infer a 0% probability or historical rate change. Input item identity independently checked against Wowhead recipe spell 391176 and TradeSkillMaster item 200641; Resonant Crystal output item 200113 checked against item database. Report is about absence of crystal, not absence of all DE materials.
stats: TWW tools vs DF tools uncertain, raised as an unverified possibility by reporter
